answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce token deposit before it may submit work, then slash that deposit when independently verified tasks reveal fraud or collusion. This makes spawning a hundred fake identities costly: each must tie up real capital, and detected Sybils lose it. A reputation echo across linked accounts can trigger closer review, while a reef of independent reviewers and a falcon-style audit spot-check reduce the chance that one fake cluster controls verification.
